enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Electrifying 2: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 2d6 Lightning damage on each hit.
Stunning +4: +4 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +2d8 damage.

children.text: This effect bestows additional benefits to those that bear the Dragonmark of Sentinel.
Least: Exotic Weapon Proficiency: Bastard Sword.

children.tooltip: Parrying I: Passive: +1 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +1 Insight bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving throws.
Insightful Fortification +25%: +25% Insight bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
